name: HYDRO_WEB_APP (Django + PyTorch + GeoDjango)
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y gdal-bin libgdal-dev libgeos-dev libproj-dev && pip install --upgrade pip && pip install torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu && pip install -r requirements.txt && python manage.py migrate
